title: The Morning Digest: October 7, 2026
dek: Brent December traded around $101.6 overnight (+1%) and WTI around $90.2 (+0.9%) after Saudi Arabia confirmed Houthi strikes on Jazan and Najran airports and a Gulf of Mexico storm formed over offshore production. Tuesday's session had Brent trading down to a $97.06 intraday low before recovering to settle $100.58 (+$0.26); WTI settled $89.44 (DTN). The diesel crack settled $102.47 Tuesday; SPR exchange bids went in with no award announced yet.
